newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's MTRC to extend Kwun Tong underground railway.
newsitem.headline: HK's MTRC to extend Kwun Tong underground railway.

text.p: Hong Kong's Mass Transit Railway Corp (MTRC) said on Friday it would extend the Kwun Tong underground railway line by one station to relieve congestion at the Quarry Bay interchange at a cost of HK$4.9 billion.

The extension to North Point station would allow travellers on the Kwun Tong Line linking Hong Kong Island and East Kowloon to change to the Island Line at both Quarry Bay and North Point, instead of just at Quarry Bay, an MTRC spokeswoman said.
"The current figure is HK$4.9 billion for the project," the spokeswoman said.
Last December, Transport Secretary Gordon Siu said the extension would cost an estimated HK$4.2 billion.
The MTRC spokeswoman said the lower figure referred to the original construction cost of the project, and excluded financing costs.
She said the MTRC expected to award a contract in September for the work, scheduled to be completed by December 2000.
